recognize_zh: 藍色複染背景中散布大量細長、略彎曲、帶串珠狀的洋紅色桿菌，抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）陽性，代表肉芽腫內有大量抗酸桿菌（AFB），提示分枝桿菌感染。
features: Numerous slender, long, slightly curved magenta-red bacilli (acid-fast positive)
Some bacilli beaded, scattered singly and in small loose clusters
Bacilli located among histiocyte nuclei in a blue methylene blue counterstained background
Occasional bacilli appear within cytoplasm of histiocytes
High organism burden in this field
describe_en: Ziehl-Neelsen stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows numerous slender, long, slightly curved and beaded magenta acid-fast bacilli dispersed among histiocytes against a blue counterstained background. The organism burden is high. Findings are consistent with mycobacterial infection involving the bone marrow; culture and molecular testing are required to distinguish Mycobacterium tuberculosis from nontuberculous mycobacteria such as M. avium complex, and a high bacillary load should prompt evaluation for immunodeficiency.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterium avium complex in immunocompromised host
ddx.vs: Typically shows sheets of histiocytes stuffed with innumerable short bacilli and poorly formed granulomas; speciation requires culture or PCR.
Branching filamentous organisms that are only weakly (modified) acid-fast, unlike the non-branching bacilli here.
Weakly acid-fast on Fite stain with clinical skin and nerve involvement, rarely presenting as marrow disease.
Artifacts vary in thickness, lie outside the focal plane of cells, and lack the uniform rod shape and beading of bacilli.
